scripts.//db:remote: Anything touching the remote D1 checks the id first: on the placeholder the API answers about uuid shape, which says nothing about the step that was skipped.
scripts.db:remote: npm run check:bindings -- d1 && wrangler d1 migrations apply reader-tts --remote
scripts.db:status: npm run check:bindings -- d1 && wrangler d1 migrations list reader-tts --remote
scripts.//pages:dev: wrangler runs the [build] command from wrangler.toml itself, so this does not repeat it.
scripts.pages:dev: npm run db:local && wrangler pages dev
scripts.//pages:deploy: Migrations run before the upload: they are additive, so the old code tolerates the new schema, while new code on an un-migrated database does not.
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run check:bindings && npm run build && npm run db:remote && wrangler pages deploy
